The pin is copied from the in-tree vendoring record named in pin_doc; a module whose vendoring recorded no revision is NOT measured (measure: false) - a base is never guessed. Every directory carrying a foreign LICENSE must sit under a module here or be declared in licenses/curated.json::directories.
